numeric_hyperparameters: code/main.py parser defaults (lines 42-112); same fixed values on all five datasets because their IDs are absent from author recipes

variant.method: code/main.py method=mowst; code/utils.py initialize_experiment forces separate/multi
variant.submethod: code/README.md first Mowst-GCN reproduction command uses pretrain_model2
variant.original_data: code/README.md first Mowst-GCN command uses false; parser default none does not construct a gate and is not executable

budget: code/main.py epoch=20000, big_epoch=20000, patience=100, big_patience=10; preserve > comparison in stopping checks
optimizer: code/train_test_engine.py MowstEngine.initialize: AdamW unless --adam; MLP+gate and GCN both use lr, lr_gate joint optimizer is unused for Mowst
inference: Algorithm 1 and code/train_test_engine.py eval_for_multi: 50 Bernoulli-route prediction draws, mean of draw accuracies; not majority vote or probability averaging

evaluation_rng_offsets.reason: Protocol requires independent replayable evaluation RNG; offsets fixed before training, no score-based selection

required_checkpoint_adaptation: save/restore MLP, GCN, gate and BN buffers together; author wrappers omit gate from saved Mowst snapshots
pretrain_validation_fix: author val_loss_vanilla indexes train_mask; use actual validation mask for stopping, strict validation ACC for pretrained checkpoint selection
